climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Slovenian appellation for wine and sparkling wine, in communes such as Krško, Brežice and Litija. Žametovka is the most planted grape at 39 percent, followed by Blaufränkisch at 19 and Welschriesling at 10.
